question: Which two deployments are candidate causes of the search latency incident from 11:10 to 11:26 UTC, and can the evidence uniquely attribute the incident to either one?
initial_context: Search p95 latency rose at 11:10 UTC after two components changed within two minutes of each other.

record-a.content: At 11:10 UTC, search-api query latency and cache-router miss rate rose in the same aggregation interval. Trace sampling was disabled, so the telemetry cannot establish which signal led the other.

record-b.content: Customers experienced slow search responses from 11:10 to 11:26 UTC in three regions. The impact record contains no component-level causal evidence.

record-c.content: 11:08 UTC search-api-2026.07.22.5 deployed. 11:09 UTC cache-router-2026.07.22.2 deployed. No other production changes completed before latency increased at 11:10 UTC.

record-d.content: At 11:22 UTC responders rolled back both recent changes as one mitigation bundle. Search latency returned to baseline at 11:26 UTC. Neither change was rolled back or tested independently.
